competing_explanation: A precision PASS would show only that the explicitly narrower uniform-random-origin estimand is resolvable with 100 scenes; it would neither establish that its mean passes nor repair the scientifically different worst-phase estimand. A precision FAIL would show that phase maximization was not the only precision bottleneck; it would not prove continuous utility unstable. The paired variance ratio is diagnostic and cannot override the frozen absolute precision gate.
